sources.title: Sources
sources.description: Which boards to scrape. Each item: { name, type, startUrl, maxPages }. type is one of: workatastartup, mkt1.

includeKeywords.title: Include title keywords
includeKeywords.description: Keep a job only if its title matches one of these (case-insensitive).

excludeKeywords.title: Exclude title keywords
excludeKeywords.description: Drop a job if its title matches one of these (takes precedence over include).

remoteOnly.title: Remote only
remoteOnly.description: Keep only roles that are remote or whose remote status is unclear (see keepIfRemoteUnknown). Drops clearly on-site roles.

keepIfRemoteUnknown.title: Keep jobs when remote status is unclear
keepIfRemoteUnknown.description: When remoteOnly is true and a job's location does not clearly say remote or on-site, keep it rather than drop it.

datasetName.title: Named dataset to write into
datasetName.description: All runs and all sources append into this one named dataset. Clay reads from here.

failIfSourceEmpty.title: Fail the run if a source returns zero raw jobs
failIfSourceEmpty.description: Early-warning that a board changed its layout. Filtering everything out is NOT a failure; scraping nothing is.

useApifyProxy.title: Route requests through Apify Proxy
useApifyProxy.description: Send scraper requests through Apify Proxy so the target sites see rotating IPs instead of the datacenter IP.
